note: Luminos evolution + containment fix. The single layer with two sprites has grown into six sprites in three semantic pairs: direction carries buy/sell mood and gravity-spring energy (existing), alert flares bright when temperature has crossed 55 or 45 in the last 5 bars and fades when stale (new), intensity pulses with raw temperature magnitude in a hot gold-to-orange-to-red color lerp independent of direction (new). Layer moved back inside chartWrap because at chart-area level the sprites were bouncing off gravity lines onto the sub-chart toolbars. Trade-off: signal coloring goes quiet in tool-only mode but tool-only is a focused mode anyway. Three new CSS variables on the layer drive the new pairs. Alert opacity gated via filter:opacity so the keyframe fade-in/fade-out stays alive. Four new keyframes with distinct drift paths so the six sprites don't visually overlap. Mobile perf preserved by reusing the v5.37.21 transition pruning. Coordination doc updated through v5.38.1.
